title: The desk can add a child as a member, with photo, birthday and address, while the privacy notice says MettleUp holds no data of anyone under 18
what: Add member accepts any date of birth that is a real day and not in the future, so a 12 or 15 year old can be added with a desk photo, mobile, address and emergency contact. Nothing warns the desk, asks for a parent's yes, or marks the member as a child. These records sit on MettleUp's server. The privacy notice says MettleUp is only for people aged 18 or over and that data of anyone under 18 is deleted once known, yet here the birthday itself tells MettleUp the person is under 18 and nothing deletes it. India's data law asks for a parent's checkable yes before a child's data is handled.
expected: Either the desk is told, when a birthday shows someone under 18, to get a parent's yes (and the gym's records of children are allowed and named in the notice), or the notice's under-18 line says it covers only the member app and not the gym's own records.
who: gyms with members under 18, and those members' parents
how_often: every time the desk adds someone under 18
fix_line: Decide how gyms handle members under 18: add a parent's-yes step on Add member when the birthday shows under 18, and make the notice's under-18 line match.
